purpose: Ride-first review of recorded trip outcome and sampled motor evidence, followed by independently sourced current vehicle signals and wider coaching/date-range context.
primaryGoal: Select a recorded or open drive, understand its totals and sampled powertrain measurements without mistaking current parked readings, heuristic coaching, or a loaded subset for selected-trip evidence.

dataSources.behavior: Both poll every 30 seconds; range query forwards inclusive startInstant/exclusive endInstantExclusive. Latest query contributes only open drives. AbortSignal is forwarded, arrays normalized, vehicle selection enables fetching. Query keys include vehicle/bounds/limit. This is a loaded subset, not a full-range aggregate.

Shared key includes vehicle/limit/start/end. Requires selected vehicle and valid selected-drive window. Completed rides stop polling; open rides poll every 30 seconds via page override. Window end is actual completion or now plus one second. Raw snapshot fields are consumed unchanged; power_kw/regen_kw are present in current frontend source, so no SI-wire compliance is inferred from naming.

Vehicle-gated 5-second polling, ['motor-latest', vehicleId], AbortSignal forwarded. Shared by live status, speed/gear, interpretation and warnings. Motor SSE fields invalidate this key; current readings never backfill ride history.

Vehicle-gated 5-second polling, ['drive-dynamics-latest', vehicleId], AbortSignal forwarded. Acceleration and pedal SSE fields invalidate key. G-force source has no observation timestamp; UI correctly does not invent one.

AutopilotSection requests 5-second polling and accepts current speed only when isVehicleStateFieldCurrent verifies it and it is finite. Verified zero is preserved. Underlying live-state backend behavior and as-of runtime integration were not exercised.

10-second polling; translates caller signal_name to wire field, unwraps and adapts envelope; AbortSignal forwarded. Page SSE invalidates vehicle prefix. Set speed uses SI display conversion; follow distance is enum suffix/bar setting, not physical distance. Continuous freshness of independent latest historical observations is explicitly not established.

Vehicle-gated 30-day model, 5-minute polling/stale time, AbortSignal forwarded. Independent of selected ride and workspace date range. Frontend fields efficiency_wh_km and patterns are existing source contracts; backend algorithm, units and completeness were not independently inspected.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Page-level selection errors coexist with independent live warnings and consumer-specific retries. This is legitimate source ownership, not a reason to replace all panels with a single page error.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Preserve per-source recovery; only deduplicate identical visible notices after actual mounted review.

states.loading: Range query shows page busy and local skeleton only without data (page:191/202-205); latest-source error is independent. Motor/live consumers have local skeleton/brief loading states; coach has a small skeleton. No global data gate removes all sections.
states.empty: Trip selector disabled with no options; RideOverview remains with EmptyState. Missing sample metrics remain unknown; histories/tips/live sources have per-panel empty states and vehicle-gated retry. No vehicle uses workspace selection, not a competing local picker.
states.error: Range/latest refetch separately. useMotorEvidence exposes fatal vs refresh error; live motor/pedals/G-force offer local recovery; state/cruise/follow fatal errors are separately recoverable through LiveSourceWarnings. Coaching retains independent fatal/retry owner.
states.staleOffline: Page and source warnings use shared DataState; retained history/live/coach payloads are intended to remain. No dedicated offline control is authored in page; actual offline DataState presentation is unverified.
states.partial: Missing G-force axis keeps combined magnitude unknown; missing both torque axles is unknown, one reported axle contributes existing partial sum; AWD interpretation share requires both axles. Cruise and follow observations remain independently scoped and not continuously current by assumption.
states.successDisabled: Open-drive badge, recorded-trip badge, semantic brake/gear states, valid source metric values and disabled empty drive Select are present.

issues.detail: This selected-history consumer still uses useMotorStats's isLoading/isError/raw error instead of exposing fatal/refresh state and a stale warning. Existing measurements render when present, but refresh failure lacks local trust metadata.
issues.fix: Consume existing useMotorEvidence/useDataState semantics while retaining all three insight surfaces, calculations, text and per-source retry.

issues.detail: Drives analyzed falls back to numeric 0 when coachData is absent; this caption can imply a measured zero during loading/error/unavailable. The score itself correctly has a missing-state guard.
issues.fix: Distinguish unknown count from real returned zero in caption and period reason; preserve the source count when known.

issues.detail: Adapter defaults status to Returned evidence whenever no loading/retained/unavailable prop is supplied, even for missing metrics. RideOverview guards its source; other callers need an explicit source-state decision rather than a blanket successful label.
issues.fix: Keep existing adapter and OperationalBrief, but supply source-derived availability/partial status in each affected caller; do not classify missing measurements as error or zero.

visualIssues.fix: Map existing thermal severity and signed-direction meanings onto shared semantic/chart tokens; preserve 80/120 C thresholds, negative/positive scales and text labels.

visualIssues.fix: Use role typography and shared semantic tokens, retaining the actual gear symbol and semantic badge; verify hierarchy in both themes.

visualIssues.detail: Physics link is fixed text-cyan-300; informational finding icons also use fixed sky-300. These are not proven contrast failures, but bypass theme-aware foreground policy.
visualIssues.fix: Use canonical theme-aware action/information foreground tokens, preserving link destination and findings.

architectureIssues.detail: Many dependencies directly import layout-reference/stat-reference paths while the page itself correctly uses category barrels. These point to existing owners, not necessarily competing implementations, but bypass production import contract.
architectureIssues.fix: Adopt @/components/layout and @/components/data-display category exports for presentation values/types wherever already available; do not build replacement wrappers.

architectureIssues.detail: Shared LayoutCard imports Button/Card/Heading/Text/Tooltip from the UI category barrel, contrary to the concrete-internal-import requirement. No actual chunk cycle was tested or asserted.
architectureIssues.fix: Dedicated shared owner should replace this barrel import with concrete existing UI module imports, retaining all props, IDs, help, focus behavior and presentation.

architectureIssues.detail: Scatter comment claims CSV availability, but this chart passes neither exportData nor data/dataColumns. Current ChartContainer exposes CSV only with exportData; exportable alone offers image capabilities.
architectureIssues.fix: Supply existing shared exportData with all loaded scatter points and accurate column/unit labels and nonvisual data, or explicitly document the actual image-only contract without claiming CSV. Prefer retaining/adding genuine data access through current shared APIs.

architectureIssues.detail: Range fetch is capped at 1000 and latest at 5. UI explains loaded trips and current drive, but selector cannot expose older rides beyond cap; server totals/pagination/completeness were not inspected.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve explicit subset semantics and limits during presentation work. If complete range selection becomes a requirement, assign separate integration/server-pagination work rather than relabeling these results complete.

architectureIssues.detail: Current source accesses power_kw/regen_kw; related consumers multiply by 1000 for operational metrics. This audit does not establish whether backend bytes carry SI or those named display units, and must not silently reinterpret or rename during modernization.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve current source/wire/cache values and calculations; any canonical-unit correction belongs to a separately verified end-to-end SI contract, not this page source audit.

dataBehavior: Never fill selected-trip sample gaps with parked/current signals.
Merge only open latest drives into bounded range, deduplicate by id with range payload precedence, sort descending start.
Honor requested URL drive if available, else first open drive, else newest start; preserve no-selection null.
Compute motor-history window only when drive start and valid end exist; exclusive end is completion/now plus 1 second; missing window disables query.
Preserve vehicle/date/timezone preferences, URL drive, range persistence, precision/locale, display-only distance/speed/temperature conversion and raw caches.
Preserve all MOTOR/DRIVE_DYNAMICS/CRUISE SSE bindings and polling fallback; do not infer query receipt time proves source freshness.
Motor statistics filter nonfinite values; sample averages are arithmetic, not time-weighted; torque uses reported axle sum, temperature uses hottest reported motor per sample.
History limit 200 and range limit 1000 remain explicit subset boundaries; latest open-drive merge can include out-of-range current drive.
Speed buckets use display-unit 0/30/60/90/120 thresholds. Scatter uses average motor power vs distance; profile takes latest 20 loaded rides, not peak acceleration.
Live torque preserves signs and existing axle aggregation; AWD share needs both axles, combined G needs both axes, brake false/zero readings are known values rather than missing.
Coach model retains fixed last-30-day scope, heuristic caveats and server source text; per-drive-score table is already intentionally omitted for this page, not a new deletion.
No page mutation, annotation creation, fullscreen opt-in, additional route, fake data or backend capability was observed or introduced.
